style: Same dark-gold editorial system as sibling pieces in this video (rank-vs-convert / seo-search-intent): near-black radial bg, League Gothic display caps, Montserrat labels, gold accent glow. A single abstracted browser/page chassis (rounded card, muted window-chrome dots, generic address pill — NOT a real captured page, no real logos/wordmarks) tells a two-beat before/after: one cluttered generic page crams every service onto itself and a confusion signal flickers/fails to lock onto any one term, versus three distinct clean chassis instances (one per service) each locking a solid ranking signal. Restrained, confident, full-frame alpha-overlay replacement for a talking-head cut-away. Deliberately excludes any fishing/casting-line visual (that metaphor belongs to the very next sibling graphic, icon-fishing-lines) — this piece owns only the one-confused-page vs many-clear-pages structural idea.

customize.note: Catalog check via `npx hyperframes@0.7.68 catalog --tag=ui --json` and `--tag=card --json` (pinned CLI has no --query flag, matching rank-vs-convert's established workaround): hits were generic transitions.dev-style primitives (dynamic-grid, micro-transitions, simulated-cursor, card-resize, gloss-sweep, tilt-card) — none styled to this project's CSS-custom-property brand system, same tradeoff every sibling in this video already hit and rejected. Hand-authored instead, directly reusing this video's proven local primitives verbatim: the browser-frame chassis (bg2 fill, gold hairline border, radial glow, topbar dots + address pill) and the badge scale_punch + glow-flash landing pulse from rank-vs-convert, applied here to THREE simultaneous smaller chassis instances instead of one. No literal browser-chrome/OS/search-engine trademark reproduction. Deliberately does NOT use a fishing-line/cast metaphor (that is icon-fishing-lines' own signature move, the very next graphic in this timeline) and does NOT reuse icon-cta-buttons' horizontal icon row — this piece's device is the single-chassis-splits-into-three transformation, distinct from both.

scenes.beat: One generic page tries to hold every service at once — Google can't lock a signal
scenes.description: Abstract browser-page chassis (dark card, gold hairline border, muted window-chrome dots + address pill) scale-grows in, centered. Inside: a headline bar and sub bar (generic wall-of-text), and below them four small pill tags — ROOFING, REMODELING, CONCRETE, PAINTING — crammed into a tight overlapping cluster with slight rotation offsets, reading as noisy/unfocused (nothing is the clear subject). A confusion-badge in the top-right corner (same corner/size as a rank badge) pops in, then cycles rapidly through ghost-text of each service word before glitching (small x-jitter + opacity flicker) and settling on a static '?' — Google can't tell what this page is about. A caption reads 'ONE PAGE TRIES TO SAY EVERYTHING.' Hard cut at 4.0s (no manual exit fade, matches this project's clip-boundary-swap convention).
scenes.motion: bg-fill fade_in 0-0.2s; browser-frame scale_grow (back.out) 0.15-0.55s; headline/sub bars fade_in stagger 0.6-0.9s; four service-tags scale_punch stagger 0.08s apart 0.75-1.15s (tight overlap, slight rotate -4deg/+3deg/-2deg/+5deg, reads crammed); confusion-badge scale_punch (back.out) at 1.3s; badge inner-label cycles through 4 stacked ghost-word spans (each fromTo opacity 0->0.8->0 over ~0.3s, sequential, no overlap) from 1.5-3.1s, then badge glitches (x jitter keyframes, finite) 3.1-3.4s and settles on static '?' glyph fade_in at 3.4s; scene1-caption fade_up at 3.5s; freeze last frame to 4.0s clip end.

scenes.beat: Same idea, split into three distinct pages — each one locks its own clear ranking signal
scenes.description: The single chassis resolves into three smaller instances of the same chassis, arranged side by side (page-card-roofing, page-card-remodel, page-card-concrete), each popping in with a snap + stagger — reads as 'the same site, now organized.' Each card carries exactly one clean headline (ROOFING / REMODELING / CONCRETE) and one content bar — no clutter. Each card's own small badge (top-right corner, same visual language as the confusion-badge) locks solid with a checkmark glyph + gold glow-flash, staggered across the three cards left to right — each page ranks for its own clear term. The piece closes on two stacked lines: 'ONE PAGE CONFUSES GOOGLE.' / 'SEPARATE PAGES GET FOUND.', then holds for a clean cut back to host footage.
scenes.motion: three page-cards fromTo scale 0.85->1 + opacity, back.out(1.9), staggered 0.1s apart from 4.0-4.32s (the split); each card's headline + content bar fade_in stagger 4.4-4.9s; each card's rank-badge scale_punch (back.out) + glow-flash landing pulse staggered 0.25s apart from 5.0-5.9s (card-roofing -> card-remodel -> card-concrete); closing-line-1 fade_up at 6.2s; closing-line-2 fade_up + glow-pulse at 6.75s; freeze-hold from ~7.1s to 8.2s.
